material_answer_quality_fixes_verified_a.description: Separate condition (`เงื่อนไขสำคัญ`) and exception (`ข้อยกเว้น / ข้อจำกัด`) bullets were previously extracted via `[^。\n]{10,220}` in `B01.ts`, cutting mid-syllable at 220 characters and triggering on substring `ต่างหาก` or historical dates `เมื่อวันที่ ...`.
material_answer_quality_fixes_verified_a.resolution: Replaced in `B01.ts` and `query.ts` with numbered-segment, word-boundary-safe complete Thai clause extraction (`cleanCompleteThaiLegalClause`): preserves complete conditions/exceptions up to clean consequence pivots (`ดังนั้น`, `กรณีดังกล่าวจึง`, etc.) and suppresses any summary clause that cannot terminate cleanly without mid-sentence truncation while preserving 100% of the verbatim RD conclusion above.

material_answer_quality_fixes_verified_a.description: Linked B02 statutory sections rendered beneath a ruling (e.g., `มาตรา 47 ทวิ` in `LSC-01`) previously rendered `Unit 1` only, omitting `Unit 2` (`วรรคสาม` non-domicile restriction).
material_answer_quality_fixes_verified_a.resolution: Updated `query.ts` to call `reassembleOrderedSectionUnits` on linked B02 statutory sections so all paragraphs (`Unit 1..N`) render end-to-end.

material_answer_quality_fixes_verified_a.description: Rulings citing quarantined external statutes/Royal Decrees (`usable_as_legal_evidence: false`, e.g. Royal Decrees 530/595 in `LSC-04`, 773 in `LSC-06`, 736 in `LSC-17`, CCC in `LSC-01`) previously put quarantine notices only in `coverage_warnings` while returning `ANSWERED` on general questions.
material_answer_quality_fixes_verified_a.resolution: Added explicit inline `ข้อจำกัดความครบถ้วนของหลักฐานกฎหมายประกอบ` inside `answer` text whenever quarantined external laws are referenced, and set `status = CONDITIONAL` on non-`exact_lookup` questions so REG24 never implies unconditional legal certainty where supporting statutory text is unverified.

material_answer_quality_fixes_verified_a.description: Compiled `rd.go.th` Revenue Code sections (`มาตรา 47 ทวิ`, `มาตรา 70`) previously displayed `1939-04-01` as if every amended paragraph took effect in 1939, and `LSC-11` comparison mode appended an unrequested 3rd ruling (`กค 0811/6874`).
